name: Jitra Half Marathon 2026
short_description: The Jitra Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1km, 10km, and 5km race held on September 19, 2026, at Darulaman Park, Jitra, Kedah, Malaysia.

faqs.question: When is the Jitra Half Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Jitra Half Marathon 2026 is scheduled for September 19, 2026. The event will be held at Darulaman Park in Jitra, Kedah, Malaysia. Registration for this race is currently open, so participants planning to take part have time to sign up and prepare ahead of the September date.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at the Jitra Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Runners can choose from three distance categories at this event: a 21.1km half marathon, which is the primary distance, along with a 10km race and a 5km race. This range of options makes the event accessible to both experienced runners and those seeking a shorter distance challenge.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register for the Jitra Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Registration prices range from RM50 to RM95 depending on the category chosen. Early bird pricing is available from RM50 to RM80, while standard pricing ranges from RM65 to RM95. The exact fee depends on which distance category a participant selects and when they register.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Jitra Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Jitra Half Marathon 2026 is organized by Bina Darulaman Berhad, commonly known as BDB. The event takes place at Darulaman Park in Jitra, Kedah, Malaysia, and is currently open for registration across its three distance categories of 21.1km, 10km, and 5km.
